title: Radio degradation and a dead zone
description: First the whole radio degrades (50 % packet loss for 20 s): links turn 'degraded', retries and dead reckoning keep the fleet moving. Then a dead zone covers the outbound road for 12 s: vehicles in it hear nobody and hold (heartbeat fail-safe); the others treat them as hazards at their last known position. Contact returns, everyone resumes.
